task.prompt:
Create an Oracle PL/SQL procedure named `sp` with exactly this signature: `sp(arg1 NUMBER, arg2 VARCHAR2, arg3 VARCHAR2, arg4 VARCHAR2)`. It returns nothing. arg1 is the age cutoff, arg2 is the driver name, arg3 is the party, arg4 is the home city.

First, for drivers older than arg1, set driver name to arg2, bump years worked on their school-bus records by 1, and when arg3 isn't null and the driver party matches it, set those school-bus records' full-time flag to T.

Then delete drivers with null party. After that, set home city to arg4 for the remaining drivers.

If arg3 isn't null, set party to arg3 for remaining drivers older than arg1, and set full-time flag to F on school-bus records for remaining drivers with party = arg3 and age <= arg1. Basically that's it.

Use only driver records and school-bus records; do not read or change school records, and do not read or change the school-bus record's own ID. Do not commit or rollback, and do not define exception handlers. Return the complete stored procedure and nothing else.

args.answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp(arg1 NUMBER, arg2 VARCHAR2, arg3 VARCHAR2, arg4 VARCHAR2)
AS
BEGIN
    -- Step 1: Update older drivers (age > arg1)
    UPDATE "driver" SET "Name" = arg2 WHERE "Age" > arg1;
    
    -- Update school-bus years for these drivers
    UPDATE "school_bus" sb
    SET "Years_Working" = "Years_Working" + 1
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM "driver" d
        WHERE d."Driver_ID" = sb."Driver_ID" AND d."Age" > arg1
    );
    
    -- If arg3 is not null, update full-time flag where party matches
    IF arg3 IS NOT NULL THEN
        UPDATE "school_bus" sb
        SET "If_full_time" = 'T'
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM "driver" d
            WHERE d."Driver_ID" = sb."Driver_ID"
            AND d."Age" > arg1
            AND d."Party" = arg3
        );
    END IF;
    
    -- Step 2: Delete drivers with null party
    DELETE FROM "driver" WHERE "Party" IS NULL;
    
    -- Step 3: Set home city for remaining drivers
    UPDATE "driver" SET "Home_city" = arg4;
    
    -- Step 4: If arg3 is not null
    IF arg3 IS NOT NULL THEN
        -- Set party for older drivers
        UPDATE "driver" SET "Party" = arg3 WHERE "Age" > arg1;
        
        -- Set full-time to 'F' for school-bus records matching conditions
        UPDATE "school_bus" sb
        SET "If_full_time" = 'F'
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM "driver" d
            WHERE d."Driver_ID" = sb."Driver_ID"
            AND d."Party" = arg3
            AND d."Age" <= arg1
        );
    END IF;
END; /
